items.title: 5 Lessons in AI Context Engineering: Why More Context Is Not Better
items.summary: Your AI agent needs to identify what a customer owns, determine which services they are entitled to, and retrieve only the records they’re authorized to see. Now imagine doing all that while keeping production customer-context lookups below 200 milliseconds at the median.
